## System

| | |
|---|---|
| **Machine** | Acer Predator Helios Neo 16 (PHN16-72): i5-14500HX, 16 GB RAM |
| **OS** | Arch Linux |
| **Kernel** | linux-cachyos-bore 7.3.0 (BORE scheduler), Arch `linux` 7.2.11.arch1 as backup |
| **Bootloader** | Limine: CachyOS, Arch Linux, Windows and the latest snapshot |
| **Boot splash** | Plymouth with my own logo |
| **Disk** | btrfs on LUKS; snapper + snap-pac take a snapshot on every pacman run |
| **Swap** | zram, plus a swapfile for hibernation |
| **Packages** | pacman, yay for the AUR, Flatpak; kernel from `[cachyos-v3]` |
| **Graphics** | Intel drives the laptop screen, NVIDIA RTX 4060 on nvidia-open |
| **Audio** | PipeWire + WirePlumber |
| **Network** | NetworkManager, ufw firewall |
| **Power** | power-profiles-daemon, thermald, intel-lpmd |

Configs:

- [`/etc/boot/hooks/post.d/40-menu-layout`](root/etc/boot/hooks/post.d/40-menu-layout): Limine hook: CachyOS / Arch Linux / Windows menu
- [`/etc/boot/hooks/post.d/50-snapshot-latest`](root/etc/boot/hooks/post.d/50-snapshot-latest): Limine hook: one "snapshot-latest" boot entry
- [`/etc/default/limine`](root/etc/default/limine): Limine settings: boot order, snapshot entries
- [`/etc/mkinitcpio.conf.d/zz-hybrid-gpu.conf`](root/etc/mkinitcpio.conf.d/zz-hybrid-gpu.conf): Keep nouveau + its firmware out of the kernel images
- [`/etc/pacman.d/mirrorlist.arch`](root/etc/pacman.d/mirrorlist.arch): Spare copy of the ranked Arch mirrorlist

- [`packages/aur.txt`](packages/aur.txt): 29 from the AUR (yay)
- [`packages/flatpak.txt`](packages/flatpak.txt): 1 from Flatpak

## Restore on a new machine

`home/` mirrors `~` and `root/` mirrors `/`, so `home/.config/hypr` goes back to `~/.config/hypr`.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/l4n1skyy/dotfiles.git ~/dotfiles
rsync -av ~/dotfiles/home/ ~/                      # put the configs back
sudo pacman -S --needed - < ~/dotfiles/packages/pacman.txt
yay -S --needed - < ~/dotfiles/packages/aur.txt
```

Secrets were replaced with `<redacted>` in `home/.bashrc`; fill those in by hand.

Not copied because they match fuck-omarchy's defaults: `.config/autostart`, `.config/starship.toml`.

## Updating

```bash
dotfiles              # copy current configs here and rebuild this README
dotfiles -n           # preview what would change
dotfiles --push       # same as `dotfiles`, then commit and push to GitHub
dotfiles -p -m "msg"  # push with your own commit message
dotfiles --edit       # edit dotfiles.conf
```

The script lives at `~/.local/bin/system/dotfiles` (copied here under `home/.local/bin/system/`).
